representation_novel_values.scope: TRAIN-only auxiliary readout; no optimizer, parameter update, evaluation-set access, or evaluation-set forward
representation_novel_values.label_definition: exact first ASCII uppercase character of the generated literal value: expected[0], A-Z
representation_novel_values.split_definition: 75/25 approximately, stratified by initial and language; union of test values makes fit/test globally value-disjoint; all 26 classes in each language fit/test
representation_novel_values.feature_definition: source token whose UTF8 byte span contains the first literal A-Z character; question-tail is final assistant role token; embedding is input to block0 including position
representation_novel_values.readout_method: train-centered unit-normalized hidden vectors; 26-class one-hot ridge readout with fixed lambda .01; no tuning on test; per-language fitting; independent readout per layer/position
limitations: These TRAIN-generated literal values are held out only from auxiliary readout fitting, not a claim that their constituent characters are unseen by the model.
High source-position first-character recovery does not establish recovery of the full value, sequence copying, language-model answer generation, causal access at the output, or benchmark improvement.
Fit/test share authored TRAIN template families; disjoint values test literal generalization rather than unseen-template generalization.
Question-tail classification may exploit positional or template/label correlations; no causal intervention or label-shuffling control is claimed.
Only one fixed ridge regularization and 512 generated context-name rows are measured; other tasks and complete target strings are outside this diagnostic.
